name: The Obsidian Penthouse
description: Perched atop the city's most iconic residential tower in Worli, The Obsidian offers an unparalleled living experience. With 360-degree views of the Arabian Sea and the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, this residence redefines urban luxury. Featuring a private infinity pool, a double-height living room, and interiors curated by international designers.

name: Bandra Heritage Manor
description: A rare opportunity to own a piece of Mumbai's history in the most prestigious Pali Hill neighborhood. This sprawling heritage manor blends colonial elegance with modern sophistication. Surrounded by centuries-old trees and lush manicured lawns, it offers complete privacy and world-class amenities in the heart of Bandra.

name: Juhu Coastal Villa
description: A minimalist masterpiece on the shores of Juhu Beach. This coastal villa features floor-to-ceiling glass walls, an open-concept layout, and direct beach access. Designed for the discerning individual who appreciates the tranquility of the ocean and the elegance of modern architecture in Mumbai's most vibrant suburb.

name: Powai Silicon Loft
description: A high-tech urban sanctuary in Mumbai's tech and startup hub, Powai. This industrial-chic loft features smart home integration, exposed brick walls, and a private terrace garden overlooking the lake. Perfect for the modern professional seeking a blend of style and substance in a vibrant, planned neighborhood.

name: South Mumbai Legacy Suite
description: Experience the pinnacle of South Mumbai living at Malabar Hill. This expansive legacy suite offers breathtaking views of the Queen's Necklace and the Arabian Sea. With classic architectural details and modern luxury upgrades, it serves as a perfect sanctuary for Mumbai's elite.
